## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d3909868caf083b0e9665908aa95526b25eafea2`
Local-runs: probe — one read-only parse of the eval JSON blob at this head (`git show` piped to a JSON parser) to cross-check every case's `must_contain` / `must_not_contain` against its own `expected_output`; nothing built, no gate run or re-run
Scope: skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json + none

Inputs read: card #33635 body and its three comments (triage 6888748066, claim 6895864936, os-dev-report 6896182022; no ruling and no earlier review record on the card); PR #33934 body, its 3-file list and the net diff against `main` (merge-base = `origin/main` = `895783a1`, +32 −6); the check-runs on this head. Remainder of the diff, `.changeset/33635-i18n-source-locale-skill.md`, is the lane seat's ACCEPT.

Check-runs on `d3909868` (read at review time): no failure. Completed `success`: Build Core, Type Check · workspace, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, the three `Lint · scoped` jobs, Test UI, Live E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Plan Test Core shards, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Auto Label, filter. STILL RUNNING, no verdict yet: Test Core (1/8), Test Core (2/8) (shards 3–8 not yet listed), Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Type Check · source gates, Lint · ESLint. The rest are `skipped` (path-filtered UI, docs build, queue verdicts, opt-in jobs). This record's verdict is on the contract; the running gates stay the merge's precondition.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set: none changes. No schema, no CLI flag, no runtime path is in the diff; `TranslationConfigSchema.sourceLocale` and its aliases already ship on `main` (PR #33357). Right.
- Public surface: the published `@objectstack/skills` text of `objectstack-i18n` gains one key-table row, a reworded `defaultLocale` row, four prose lines, two "default locale" → "source locale" rewordings and a moved `--default-locale` sentence; the eval file gains case 11. Additive teaching of behaviour already on `main`; no existing teaching is withdrawn. Right.
- `--default-locale` leaves the trailing flag list of the extract section and is taught one sentence earlier — the flag is still named once, not dropped. Right.
- The top-of-skill config example keeps `defaultLocale: 'en'`: correct for an English-default app, and the new prose scopes "never `defaultLocale: 'en'`" to the English-authored / Chinese-users case. Right.
- Token-ratchet row untouched (file stays under its ceiling per the PR's reading; `Lint · repo & tooling gates` is the gate and is still running). No judgment owed beyond that.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/33635-i18n-source-locale-skill.md` declares `'@objectstack/skills': patch`; `packages/skills/package.json` is `@objectstack/skills`. The diff publishes prose and one eval case only — patch matches. `Check Changeset` is `success` on this head. The changeset body's own claims (precedence, the three commands, the `fallbackLocale: 'en'` consequence) agree with the tree as read in ④.

Clause-②: no — consistent across the claim (6895864936), the PR body and the changeset; nothing in the diff narrows an accept-set or removes a declared capability. `Metadata-protocol: none` likewise holds: no metadata shape moves.

### ③ Boundary flags

PR author login: `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay); attribution `github_login: os-steve`, assignee `os-steve`; PR is a draft, `mergeable_state: blocked`. The implementing thread is `session_01ADHkmSpA1arrHg2f7Nwofb` on branch `claude/project-thread-jl3xcf`; this record is adopted by a different session.

- `open_questions` (os-dev-report 6896182022): empty. Nothing to answer.
- Deviation "model tier" (report + PR Acceptance notes): authoring ran in a subagent pinned to the contract-review tier because the card thread is served at the default tier. Answered as far as this review can: the three inputs do not let a reviewer verify which model served the authoring, so the claim is recorded, not confirmed; the diff was judged on its content in ④ regardless. If the lane needs that proven, it is the seat's to establish — escalated to the seat, not a finding on the diff.
- Deviation "one session-URL footer": `PR-body guards` is `success` on this head. Accepted.
- `out_of_scope_findings` / "Not taught, on purpose" (two facts: `sourceLocale` need not be in `supportedLocales`; with `sourceLocale` declared, `defaultLocale` is gated and scaffolded even when `supportedLocales` omits it): both verified true on `main` (`translation.zod.ts` jsdoc on `sourceLocale`; `resolveGatedDefaultLocale` / `withGatedDefaultLocale` in `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts`) and both carried by `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx`. Omitting them makes nothing the skill says false and is not required by the card's Work list. Accepted, no carrier owed.
- Card Work item 3 ("state the serving-layer caveat … declare `fallbackLocale` until the companion serving card lands"): the skill states the caveat and names no card and no future behaviour ("still" is the only forward-looking word). #33634 is the open serving half per triage. Accepted.
- Security: neither `hits` file teaches security, auth or permission behaviour. The caveat concerns which locale's text a label request resolves to (`metaTranslateOptions` in `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`), not who may read it.

### ④ Design judgment

**skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md** — every new or changed sentence checked against `main`:

- `defaultLocale` = "the locale a user who has not chosen one gets": matches the `sourceLocale` jsdoc in `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` ("which language a user who has not chosen one gets"). True.
- `sourceLocale` row — optional, defaults to `defaultLocale`, the language inline `label:` text is written in, read by `os lint`, `os i18n check`, `os i18n extract`: `sourceLocale: LocaleSchema.optional()`; `resolveSourceLocale` returns `sourceLocale`, else `defaultLocale`, else `'en'`; `lint.ts` and `i18n/check.ts` reach it through `computeI18nCoverage` (`opts.defaultLocale ?? resolveSourceLocale(declared)`), `i18n/extract.ts` calls it directly. True.
- Precedence `--default-locale`, then `i18n.sourceLocale`, then `i18n.defaultLocale`, then `en`: `flags['default-locale'] ?? resolveSourceLocale(declared)` in extract; `defaultLocale: flags['default-locale']` into `computeI18nCoverage` in lint and check; all three flag help texts say the same. True, and "for one run" is right (a flag, nothing persisted).
- "`defaultLocale: 'zh-CN', sourceLocale: 'en'`, never `defaultLocale: 'en'`": the spec's own worked case and the docs' example. True.
- Serving caveat — "Label serving still reads inline text as `defaultLocale` text: with no `fallbackLocale: 'en'`, an `en` request reaches the zh-CN bundle before the English inline label": `metaTranslateOptions` threads `getFallbackLocale()` and `getDefaultLocale()`; `localeChain` in `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` skips the chain only for a `defaultLocale` request; `FileI18nAdapter` is built with `fallbackLocale || defaultLocale || 'en'` (`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`). So with `defaultLocale: 'zh-CN'` and no `fallbackLocale`, an `en` request walks `en → zh-CN → authored label`; with `fallbackLocale: 'en'` it walks `en → authored label`. True, and the remedy works. No unshipped behaviour is promised; nothing says `sourceLocale` will or does reach the serving layer.
- "`sourceLanguage`, `authoringLocale` and `authoringLanguage` are refused, each naming `sourceLocale`": all three are in `TranslationConfigSchema`'s `strictObject` `aliases`, each mapped to `sourceLocale`; `stack.zod.ts` validates `i18n` with that schema. True.
- "Gaps in the source locale are errors, `--strict` promotes the rest": `isError = locale === defaultLocale || opts.strict === true`, where `defaultLocale` is the resolved source locale. True — and the old wording ("default locale") was the false one on a stack declaring `sourceLocale`.
- "the source locale is filled from schema labels": `generateI18nBundles` fills the locale it is handed as `defaultLocale`, which extract resolves as above. True.
- No stale "default locale" phrasing remains elsewhere in the file; `references/_index.md` names neither.
- Against the card's scenario (English-authored app, Chinese users): the skill now gives the agent `defaultLocale: 'zh-CN'` + `sourceLocale: 'en'` + `fallbackLocale: 'en'` in one place, and both failure modes the card names (losing the users' default; false "missing en" findings) are closed by what is taught. Holds.

**skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json** — case 11:

- The blob parses; 11 cases. Case 11: every `must_contain` string (`sourceLocale`, `defaultLocale: 'zh-CN'`, `fallbackLocale: 'en'`, `supportedLocales`) is in its `expected_output`; neither `must_not_contain` string (`defaultLocale: 'en'`, `sourceLanguage`) is. Cases 1–10 are unchanged and equally self-consistent.
- The `expected_output` is true on `main`: `en` is treated as the source by the three commands, extract fills the `en` bundle from inline text, the rows asked for are the non-source ones, and the `fallbackLocale: 'en'` sentence is the caveat verified above.
- The prompt is answerable from the skill text at this head alone.

Findings:

S1 (should-fix) — case 11 forbids two strings the skill at this same head hands the answering agent in "form to avoid" framing. SKILL.md line 50–51 teaches "never `defaultLocale: 'en'`" and line 53 "`sourceLanguage` … are refused"; case 11's `must_not_contain` is `["defaultLocale: 'en'", "sourceLanguage"]`. An answer that is correct and faithfully restates either warning ("do not set `defaultLocale: 'en'`", "`sourceLanguage` is refused") is graded wrong — the exact trap the package's own changelog records ("a `must_not_contain` assertion fails an answer that contains the string anywhere, including a sentence naming it as the form to avoid"). The reference answer dodges it by not repeating the warning, so the repo's cross-check passes, but the skill sentence and the assertion pull against each other. Fix either side: e.g. drop `sourceLanguage` from `must_not_contain` (a near-miss key is a build refusal, not a silent wrong answer) and make the first entry the shape only a wrong answer writes, or reword the skill's "never" clause so it does not spell the forbidden literal. Not a must-fix: nothing the skill teaches is false, and the case's own record is self-consistent.

N1 (nit) — the caveat sentence describes the standard boot (`I18nServicePlugin` / `FileI18nAdapter`, where the fallback collapses to `defaultLocale`). Under the kernel's in-memory i18n fallback there is no `getFallbackLocale()`, so an `en` request with no `fallbackLocale` goes straight to the authored label; and in either boot the zh-CN bundle is reached only for keys the `en` bundle lacks (after `os i18n extract` fills `en`, it answers first). The advice — declare `fallbackLocale: 'en'` — is right in every case; no change needed.

No must-fix.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-jl3xcf`
Reviewed-by: `session_01ADHkmRxXmVQ41fqnaTPGAv`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `5b52d0885152a60783defcfe26b73bb7f1bd89a6`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json + none

Delta record. It follows the review of `d3909868caf083b0e9665908aa95526b25eafea2` (PASS, S1 should-fix, N1 nit) and judges the one new commit `5b52d088` (`d3909868..5b52d088`: SKILL.md 1 line, eval file 1 line) on top of it. Everything the earlier record found true of the unchanged lines stands: the net diff against `main` (merge-base `895783a1`) is still the same three files, +32 −6, and the changeset is byte-identical. The changeset stays the lane seat's ACCEPT.

Check-runs on `5b52d088` (read at review time): no failure. Completed `success`: Build Core, Type Check · workspace / source gates / consumer gates / debt ledger, TypeScript Type Check, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, the three `Lint · scoped` jobs, Lint & Repo Gates, Test Core (2/8), Test UI, Live E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Plan Test Core shards, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Auto Label, filter. STILL RUNNING, no verdict yet: Test Core (1/8); shards 3–8 are not yet listed. The rest are `skipped`.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set and public surface: unchanged from the earlier record. The delta rewords one clause of already-new prose and swaps one `must_not_contain` entry; it publishes nothing further. Right.
- The token-ratchet gate (`Lint · repo & tooling gates`) is now `success` on this head, which settles the one point the earlier record left to a running gate.

### ② Semver level

`'@objectstack/skills': patch` — unchanged and still what the diff publishes; `Check Changeset` is `success` on this head. The changeset body does not quote the reworded clause or the removed assertion, so it needs no edit.

Clause-②: no — unchanged; the delta narrows nothing. `Metadata-protocol: none` holds.

### ③ Boundary flags

PR author login: `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay; attribution `os-steve`); still a draft, `mergeable_state: blocked`. Card #33635 carries the same three comments; no new flag and no new `open_questions` entry arrived with the delta. The earlier answers stand, including the model-tier deviation left with the seat.

- New, for the seat (PR body, not the tree): the PR body still describes head `d3909868` — it quotes "never `defaultLocale: 'en'`", says case 11 "must not contain `defaultLocale: 'en'` or `sourceLanguage`", and dates every reading to `d3909868`. The tree is what was judged; the body's account is now stale on those three points and is the seat's to refresh.
- Security: unchanged — neither `hits` file teaches security, auth or permission behaviour.

### ④ Design judgment

**skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md** — line 50–51 now reads: an app authored in English for Chinese users declares `defaultLocale: 'zh-CN', sourceLocale: 'en'`, "not an English `defaultLocale`".

- True: it says the same thing the old clause said — in that scenario `defaultLocale` is the users' locale, zh-CN, not the authoring language — and agrees with the `sourceLocale` jsdoc in `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` and `resolveSourceLocale` on `main`.
- Clear: the clause sits directly after the correct pair, so "an English `defaultLocale`" can only mean setting the key to the authoring language. It is scoped by the sentence's subject to the English-authored / Chinese-users app and does not contradict the English-default examples at lines 35 and 147.
- Nothing else in the file moved.

**skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json** — case 11 `must_not_contain` is now `["defaultLocale: 'en'", "sourceLocale: 'zh-CN'"]`.

- Self-consistent: neither string is in the case's `expected_output` (which spells `sourceLocale: 'en'` and `defaultLocale: 'zh-CN'`); the four `must_contain` strings are unchanged and present. Read off the blob; the JSON edit is one array element on one line.
- `sourceLocale: 'zh-CN'` is the shape only a wrong answer writes: the two keys swapped. No sentence of the skill spells it, and no correct answer to the prompt has a reason to.
- `sourceLanguage` is no longer forbidden, so an answer restating line 53's refusal is no longer graded wrong.

S1: closed. Both halves are fixed: the skill no longer hands the answering agent `defaultLocale: 'en'` in a "form to avoid" sentence, and the near-miss key is out of the assertion. No `must_not_contain` string of case 11 appears in any SKILL.md sentence a correct answer to its prompt would quote.

Lines 35 and 147 still carry `defaultLocale: 'en'`, inside config examples for an English-default app. That does not reopen S1: they are code a correct answer would adapt (writing `'zh-CN'`), not a warning it would restate, and an answer that copies the literal for this prompt has written the wrong config — which is what the assertion is for. The remaining exposure is an answer that volunteers the contrast ("an English-default app would write …") with the literal spelled out; that is the residual every wrong-answer-shape assertion in this package carries, and is recorded as a nit only.

N1 (nit, carried) — the caveat describes the standard boot; unchanged, no action.
N2 (nit) — the residual above: a correct answer that spells `defaultLocale: 'en'` while contrasting with the English-default case would still fail case 11. No change asked.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-jl3xcf`
Reviewed-by: `session_01ADHkmRxXmVQ41fqnaTPGAv`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` 的 `i18n` 键表新增 `sourceLocale` 一行(内联 `label:` 文字的语言,缺省等于 `defaultLocale`,`os lint`、`os i18n check`、`os i18n extract` 读它);`defaultLocale` 改述为「用户没选语言时得到的语言」;表下四行写明英文编写、中文用户的配法和 `fallbackLocale: 'en'` 的服务端注意事项;`--default-locale` 说明改为覆盖源语言。评测新增第 11 条;`@objectstack/skills` patch changeset。
- 为什么改:卡 #33635(p2),PR #33357 新增 `sourceLocale` 后技能欠的那行。不教的话,AI 给英文编写、卖给中国用户的应用会写 `defaultLocale: 'en'`,丢掉用户默认语言,或得到大量误报的「缺 en」。
- 风险与回滚:只改技能文字和一条评测,不动运行时。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:SKILL.md 键表下方那四行(服务端注意事项一句,未承诺 #33634 尚未落地的行为)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期 i18n 行 6146 / 6333 通过。
- 需要你做的:受管面 Tier H(`skills/**`)。达档(CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER)复审:首轮 6896242184(PASS,S1 should-fix),delta 6896469196 在本 head PASS、S1 已关。请批准或直接合并。
- 席位意见:可以合。

## 席位核对

**Verdict: ACCEPT, held for the maintainer** · head `5b52d0885152a60783defcfe26b73bb7f1bd89a6` · card #33635 · report 6896182022 · at-tier contract review 6896242184 (round 1) + delta 6896469196 (PASS on this head, `S1: closed`).

- **Shape:** draft → `main`, `Fixes #33635`. `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`, `skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json`, one changeset (`@objectstack/skills` patch). **GOVERNED**, Tier H (`skills/**`). `Clause-②: no`; `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **Premise measured:** `Blocked-by: #33232` closed (PR #33357 merged); `sourceLocale` absent from the skill on `main`; the serving card #33634 is open, so the caveat promises nothing unshipped.
- **Gates:** check-runs on this head: 48, 30 success, 18 skipped, none failing or pending. Dev: 47 derived, 47 exit 0, `--ran` reconciles.
- **Changeset (read sentence by sentence against the diff):** the precedence `i18n.sourceLocale`, else `i18n.defaultLocale`, else `en`, the three commands, `--default-locale` overriding for one run, and the `fallbackLocale: 'en'` serving note each match the diff and `main`.
- **Accepted deviations:** authoring ran in a subagent pinned to `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` inside a default-tier card thread (recorded in the body); N1 the caveat describes the standard boot (advice right everywhere); N2 a correct answer that spells `defaultLocale: 'en'` while contrasting with the English-default case would still fail case 11.
- **Out of scope:** none filed.
- **Landing:** Tier H. The seat does not flip this PR ready or enqueue it. It needs the maintainer's merge, or an authorised APPROVED review after which the seat lands it.
